# GET /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/labels

Get all labels of a repository with pagination

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** token (optional for public repos) · **ID:** `ep-357`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |
| page | query | integer | False |
| limit | query | integer | False |

## Response

**200** — []api.Label

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `id` | int64 | Label ID |
| `name` | string | Label name |
| `exclusive` | bool | Whether label is exclusive |
| `is_archived` | bool | Whether label is archived |
| `color` | string | Hex color without # |
| `description` | string | Label description |
| `url` | string | API URL for this label |
